Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

morning, quick update on the scanner loan between Cedar and Harbor branches. Cedar's ScanPro 4 is the unit we’re lending for Harbor’s oral-history appointments next week. The loan runs from Tuesday, May 14, through Friday, May 24, and the signed checkout sheet is in the blue folder by my desk.

Luis — 8:46
thanks, Nora. I can take it over after the delivery run, but I need the receiving desk hours and a name for the handoff. The van is scheduled at Cedar at 10:30, then I’m going to the school drop-off before heading east.

Nora — 8:49
Imani at Harbor is the requested recipient, and Luis, I’m asking you to hand the scanner directly to her, not leave it at the front counter. She’s covering the oral-history room on Tuesday and will be there until 4:00.

yep, I’ll be in room 2 from 9 to 4. the staff entrance is on Alder Street, beside the book-return slot. If the side door is locked, ring the bell marked “Harbor staff”; the public entrance has construction fencing this week.

nice, thanks Jules. The asset number on the sheet now matches the unit. The case has the USB cable, two spare batteries, the wrist strap, and the small cleaning cloth; the charging dock stays at Cedar.

Imani — 9:09
that’s useful. We’ll use the scanner for consent forms and photo captions, not for the bound diaries. The diaries are too fragile to feed through anything, and the archivist has a flatbed booked for those pages.

what’s the best way to record the transfer? I can get Imani’s signature on the paper copy, but the library van won’t have a printer. I can take a phone photo if that works for the return file.

please get her signature on the paper sheet, then send me a clear photo in this thread. I’ll attach it to the loan record when I’m back at my desk. Don’t photograph any patron forms that happen to be nearby.

the forms will be in a closed folder until the appointments start. I can sign the equipment sheet outside room 2, and there’s a blank counter there with enough light for a readable photo. I’ll keep the serial sticker visible.

that condition matters for the paper sheet too; if the page gets wet, ask Imani to sign a dry copy from the front-office drawer rather than trying to dry the first one. The drawer label is “equipment forms,” second slot.

Imani — 9:39
there are two copies of the checkout sheet in that drawer, both blank. I’ll write the return date as May 24, not May 25, since Harbor closes early on Friday and we need the scanner back at Cedar before the weekend appointments.

Jules — 9:43
I also put a small card in the case with the quick-start steps. it says hold the power button for two seconds, choose “document,” and set the resolution to 300 dpi. The default profile is already saved under Harbor Oral History.

Nora — 9:47
thanks. Please don’t change the saved profile at Cedar; the preset keeps the file names in the format the archive team asked for. Harbor can adjust brightness on individual scans, but leave the destination folder set to the encrypted loan drive.

Imani — 9:52
we tested that drive last month with the training sheet, and it mounted on the room 2 laptop without an admin login. I’ll use the laptop by the window, not the public kiosk, since the kiosk clears its downloads every night.

Luis — 10:03
my route got pushed back ten minutes because the school van is blocking the west exit. I still expect to leave Cedar around 10:40. I’ll message again when I’m at the Harbor staff entrance, so no one has to wait outside.

Priya — 10:08
Harbor front desk knows a library delivery is coming, but they weren’t given the equipment details. I told them the recipient is Imani and that Luis should ring the staff bell; I didn’t ask them to sign for it.

Nora — 10:12
perfect, Imani remains the person receiving the scanner and signing the sheet. If you’re pulled into an appointment when Luis arrives, tell him to wait in the staff vestibule for you rather than hand it to another employee.

Imani — 10:16
understood. My first appointment is at 1:00, and the room is free before then. I’ll put a “staff delivery, please ring bell” note on the inside door, not the public entrance, so visitors don’t follow him in.

Luis — 10:41
leaving Cedar now. the case is strapped to the cart, and I have the two blank checkout copies in a folder in the cab. I checked that the cart wheels are locked before loading it.

Jules — 10:45
quick correction to my earlier note: the spare batteries are in the side pocket, not under the foam. Nothing else changed, and the cleaning cloth is in its sleeve beside the USB cable.

Luis — 11:18
at Harbor, using the covered bay because the rain started on Alder just before I turned in. I’m at the staff entrance now, case still closed. I’ll ring the Harbor staff bell and wait for Imani.

Imani — 11:22
I’m here. I’ll check SP4-118 against the sheet, look over the case contents, and sign the copy with the May 24 return date. Luis can send the photo to Nora after I’ve checked that no patron paperwork is in the frame.

Nora — 11:27
thanks, that’s the right order. I’ll be away from my desk until 1:30, but the loan record is already open with the branch names, dates, and asset number. Please keep the signed sheet with the case paperwork until I attach the photo.

Imani — 11:34
we’re set up for the afternoon appointments. The scanner is on the room 2 side table, away from the window, and the case and accessories are together on the lower shelf. I left the quick-start card visible for the volunteer who starts at 12:30.

Luis — 11:38
photo sent to Nora in this thread; it shows the signed equipment sheet and the asset sticker, with the patron folders out of view. I’m heading back to Cedar with the empty cart now, not the scanner.

Nora — 1:42
I’ve attached the photo to the loan record. The return plan is still Friday, May 24, with Imani handing the scanner to whoever Cedar assigns for pickup. If Harbor’s last appointment runs late, message here so we can coordinate the door handoff.", "output": "Nora — 8:42
